title: Anomaly Detector
description:
A pipeline monitoring component that detects anomalies in numeric output values using 
statistical methods. It supports Z-Score, IQR (Interquartile Range), and Rolling Average 
deviation detection with configurable sensitivity and window sizes. Detected anomalies are 
classified by severity (normal, warning, critical) and added to document metadata.</br>
</br>
Use this node to monitor pipeline outputs for unexpected patterns, outliers, or shifts 
in data distribution that may indicate issues requiring attention.
